sub_strands.title: Overview of Wood Technology
learning_outcomes: a) explore the development of Wood Technology as an area of study
b) relate the benefits of studying Wood Technology to different careers for self-development
c) appreciate the role of wood technology in the development of the economy
learning_experiences: brainstorm on the development of Wood Technology as an area of study
search online on the evolution of Wood Technology
discuss in groups the benefits and careers in Wood Technology
participate in a career talk by resource persons from different wood related sectors
discuss in groups, the importance of Wood Technology in economic development
key_inquiry_questions: Why is wood technology important as an area of study?
What are the careers related to wood technology?

sub_strands.title: Wood Workshop
learning_outcomes: a) describe features of a wood workshop
b) illustrate the layout of a wood workshop
c) explain reasons for observing safety in the wood workshop
d) appreciate the importance of different features in a Wood workshop
learning_experiences: brainstorm on features of a wood workshop
visit workshops in the school and community to identify different features
use digital devices to search for features of a wood workshop
sketch and display the layout of a wood workshop
discuss reasons for observing safety in the wood workshop
key_inquiry_questions: Why is it important to have specific features in a wood workshop?
Why should a wood workshop have a proper layout?

sub_strands.title: Hand Tools and Equipment
learning_outcomes: a) identify different types of hand tools and equipment in the workshop
b) classify different hand tools in the wood workshop
c) demonstrate safe use of hand tools and equipment in wood workshop
learning_experiences: use visual aids to identify hand tools used in wood workshop
categorise the classes of woodworking hand tools; measuring, marking out, cutting, sharpening, boring, planing, impelling, holding/clamping, tools shaping
brainstorm different types of hand tools and equipment in wood workshop
key_inquiry_questions: Why is it important to use hand tools correctly?
Why is it important to care for and maintain hand tools in the wood workshop?

sub_strands.title: Preparation of Wood
learning_outcomes: a) select appropriate tools and equipment for wood preparation
b) describe the processes involved in wood preparation
c) carry out different operations on prepared wood
d) appreciate the importance of wood preparation for a product.
learning_experiences: discuss in groups tools and equipment used for wood preparation (handsaw, tenon saw, jack plane, try square, marking gauge, bench hook)
brainstorm on the procedure of truing up the stock in preparation of wood
search online on procedures of truing up stock (face side, face edge, width/thickness, length)
execute different processes on timber; (chamfering, beveling, rebating, grooving, housing, mitring, shaping, boring holes)
visit a nearby workshop to observe the preparation of wood.
key_inquiry_questions: Why is it necessary to carry out wood preparations?

sub_strands.title: Wood Working Joints
learning_outcomes: a) identify different types of joints in wood work
b) classify types of joints in wood work
c) prepare joints used in wood work
d) identify fasteners used in strengthening woodworking joints
e) appreciate the role of wood working joints in making of wood product.
learning_experiences: discuss different types of joints in wood work
discuss classification of wood joints (lengthening, widening and framing)
sketch woodworking joints (lengthening, widening and framing)
use video clips to show how to prepare and assemble different woodworking joints
use visual aids to identify different fasteners used in wood working joints (screws nails dowels)
visit nearby wood workshops to observe the application of wood joints.

sub_strands.title: Surface Preparation
learning_outcomes: a) explain the reasons for finishing a wood product
b) select materials and tools for surface preparation
c) prepare a wood surface to receive clear varnish
d) appreciate the importance of preparing of wood surfaces to receive finishes.
learning_experiences: discuss in groups reasons for finishing a product.
discuss in groups materials, tools that are required for surface preparation( scraper, sand paper, files hot iron and cloth)
visit a neighborhood workshop to learn the preparation of surface (Scraping, raising the grain, hand sanding)
search online for
key_inquiry_questions: Why is surface preparation in wood finishing important?

sub_strands.title: Drawing and sketching
learning_outcomes: a) identify different types of pictorial drawings used in wood technology
b) draw shapes of items to be made in isometric projection
c) draw orthographic views from isometric projections
d) make freehand sketches of items for designs purposes
e) embrace the use of drawing in design of items to be produced in the workshop.
learning_experiences: use digital device to identify different types of pictorial drawings (oblique, isometric, perspective)
use drawing instruments to make isometric drawings
interpret drawings from isometric to orthographic projection
make freehand sketches of possible designs for use in production
key_inquiry_questions: What is the importance of drawing in wood technology?
How can you make use of drawings in the design process?
